title: New QEI Clinic opens in Clayfield
excerpt: We are excited to announce that Queensland Eye Institute is establishing a new clinic in Clayfield.
body_html:
We are excited to announce that Queensland Eye Institute is establishing a new clinic in Clayfield. The new QEI Clinic will enable us to welcome new clinicians and more importantly, to assist and support more patients. The lease on our new premises has been signed, the architectural plans developed and the build has commenced.

The 522m² facility is in a centrally located area of Brisbane’s Northside, at 695 Sandgate Road, Clayfield 4011.

“Our latest QEI Clinic is a great opportunity to continue delivering an outstanding level of clinical care to our patients and expand our services,” says QEI’s CEO, Professor Mark Radford.

The new clinic will open in early July 2019.
